fact: In its fourth-quarter 2025 issue the tax directorate reports that digitised questionnaires and satellite measurement were used to collect property data for the unique property tax in six pilot communes (Dangbo, Adjohoun, Bonou, Avrankou, Adjarra, Adja-Ouèrè) and one district of Sèmè-Podji.
title: Le Messager des impôts N°48
publisher: Direction Générale des Impôts du Bénin
